classification.difficultyReason: Use equal opposite sides from the diagram to set up two short independent equations per rectangle. Fraction answers, little modelling.

content.prompt: Find the values of $x$ and $y$ in each rectangle.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}3x+4&=19\\3x&=15\\x&=5\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}2y&=7\\y&=3.5\end{align*}$$

Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}4x-5&=7\\4x&=12\\x&=3\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}3y-1&=9\\3y&=10\\y&=\frac{10}{3}\end{align*}$$
